input.summary: Tungabhadra Actives LLP (V02), contact Anand. Quoted for RFx KPC-2026-014 with Niacinamide COA and a footnote (not reviewed here). Latest reply: RM-001 propanediol drum is 215 kg net, so 2 drum MOQ is about 430 kg (to confirm). Open: RM-003 COA dated 2026-03-10 is over 6 months old (tries left 2). Knockouts Q5 (COA per line), Q9 (SDS and leave-on suitability), Q10 (2-8 C cold chain) unanswered. Q8 (manufacturer or trader) open. Response deadline 14 Nov 2026. No commitments made.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014 - Thank you, remaining items needed
input.body:
Dear Anand,

Thank you for confirming that the propanediol drum is 215 kg net.

Please confirm the following so we can complete our evaluation:

1. RM-001 MOQ: please confirm that the MOQ of 2 drums equals 430 kg.

2. RM-003 Niacinamide: the COA dated 10 March 2026 is more than 6 months old. Please send a COA from a recent batch showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.

3. Certificates of Analysis from a recent batch for each line in your quote, showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.

4. The Safety Data Sheet for each material, and confirmation that each is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

5. Can you deliver with an unbroken 2-8 C cold chain? Please describe your packaging and temperature logging.

6. Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Please name the manufacturer and site, any second source, and whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Items 3, 4 and 5 are mandatory for us to proceed. Please reply by 14 November 2026.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
